title: French-Style Grilled Lentil Skewers
description: A flavorful and healthy French-inspired dish made with grilled lentil skewers, perfect for a quick and easy meal. This recipe combines the aromatic spices of the Middle East with the classic French technique of grilling.

ingredients.name: Lentils
ingredients.notes: Green or brown lentils work well for this recipe.

ingredients.name: Aromatic Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: Use a pre-mixed blend or make your own with cumin, coriander, and paprika.

ingredients.name: Saudi Arabian Olive Oil
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality olive oil for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Arabian Salt
ingredients.notes: Use a flaky sea salt or a coarse kosher salt.

ingredients.name: Fresh Cilantro
ingredients.notes: Chopped fresh cilantro adds a bright and refreshing flavor to the dish.

ingredients.name: Grill Skewers
ingredients.notes: Use wooden or metal skewers, depending on your preference.

ingredients.name: Lemon Juice
ingredients.notes: Freshly squeezed lemon juice adds a nice acidity to the dish.

instructions: 1. Rinse the lentils and soak them in water for at least 30 minutes. Drain and set aside.
2. In a small bowl, mix together the aromatic spice blend, Arabian salt, and lemon juice.
3. Thread the lentils, onion, and cilantro onto the grill skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
4. Brush the skewers with the Saudi Arabian olive oil and sprinkle with the spice blend mixture.
5. Preheat the grill to medium-high heat and cook the skewers for 8-10 minutes, or until the lentils are tender and lightly charred.
6. Serve the grilled lentil skewers hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
